market_view.rationale: Massive FII net buying exceeding ₹36,000 crore over three sessions is driving strong top-heavy momentum, lifting Nifty 50 and Bank Nifty over 2%. However, elevated volatility (INDIA VIX at 17.47) and negative returns across mid and small-cap indices signal that swing trades must remain strictly focused on liquid, front-line leaders.

sector_pick.name: NIFTY IT
sector_pick.rationale: NIFTY IT retains premier structural relative strength with a market-leading 18.81% one-month return.

last_week_review: Last week's bullish view held up well for large caps as massive FII inflows sparked a 2%+ surge in the Nifty 50, though small-cap drag confirmed the need for selective positioning.
